note: For learner-facing French, de is fundamentally a preposition; the noun label is noisy and unsupported by the displayed core meaning.
le functions as the masculine singular definite article/determiner and as a masculine direct-object pronoun; the noun label is misleading for this entry.
me is an unstressed object/reflexive pronoun in ordinary modern French; the noun label is learner-noise.
se is an unstressed reflexive/reciprocal pronoun; the noun label is not appropriate for the learner entry.
proposed_english: oneself; himself; herself; themselves; each other (reflexive/reciprocal use)

note: comme is not only a conjunction: in common learner use it also functions as a comparative/prepositional marker and adverbial element ('like/as/how').
